focus.title: 美国拟扩大对华半导体出口管制，新增量子计算与先进封装物项
focus.summary: 华盛顿时间9月23日，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）发布拟议规则，计划将量子计算设备、先进封装技术及部分高温超导材料纳入对华出口管制清单，并扩大“外国直接产品规则”（FDPR）适用范围至使用美国技术设计的第三国芯片。新规拟设60天公众评议期，预计2027年初生效。中国出海企业需紧急排查供应链中涉美技术节点，评估合同不可抗力与合规风险，并考虑向BIS提交评论意见。
focus.title_en: US Moves to Expand Semiconductor Export Controls on China, Targeting Quantum and Advanced Packaging
focus.summary_en: On September 23, the US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued a proposed rule to add quantum computing equipment, advanced packaging technologies, and certain high-temperature superconducting materials to the export control list for China, while broadening the Foreign Direct Product Rule (FDPR) to cover third-country chips designed with US technology. The rule carries a 60-day public comment period and is expected to take effect in early 2027. Chinese companies should urgently audit US technology touchpoints in their supply chains, assess force majeure and compliance risks, and consider submitting comments to BIS.
focus.source_en: Source: US Department of Commerce, BIS · 2026.09.24

case.title: 新加坡仲裁案：中国卖方因不可抗力主张免责被驳回，凸显合同条款设计关键
case.summary: 新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）近期公布一起涉华裁决：中国卖方以疫情后供应链中断构成不可抗力为由拒绝交货，仲裁庭认为合同未明确列举该情形且卖方未及时通知，故不构成免责。仲裁庭强调，不可抗力条款应具体列明事件类型、通知时限及减损义务，否则难以获得支持。该案对跨境贸易合同起草具有警示意义，建议中国企业在合同中细化不可抗力定义并约定替代履行方案。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）案例摘要 · 2026年9月
case.title_en: SIAC Tribunal Rejects Chinese Seller's Force Majeure Defense, Highlighting Contract Drafting Pitfalls
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) recently published an award involving a Chinese seller that refused delivery, citing post-pandemic supply chain disruptions as force majeure. The tribunal rejected the defense, finding the contract did not expressly list such events and the seller failed to give timely notice. The tribunal stressed that force majeure clauses must specify event types, notice periods, and mitigation duties to be enforceable. The case underscores the need for Chinese companies to refine force majeure definitions and provide for alternative performance in cross-border contracts.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动“白名单”机制，便利企业合规传输
policy.summary: 广东省近日发布《粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化试点方案》，建立“白名单”机制，允许符合条件的企业在金融、医疗、贸易等领域向港澳传输数据，无需逐笔申报。试点覆盖广州、深圳、珠海等九市，企业需通过数据保护能力认证并承诺遵守港澳相关法律。该政策有望降低合规成本，但企业仍须关注港澳隐私法规差异，建议建立内部数据分类分级制度并保留传输记录。
policy.source: 来源：广东省人民政府新闻办 · 2026年9月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches Cross-Border Data Flow Whitelist to Ease Compliance Burden
policy.summary_en: Guangdong Province has released a pilot plan to facilitate cross-border data flows within the Greater Bay Area, establishing a whitelist mechanism that allows qualified enterprises in finance, healthcare, and trade to transfer data to Hong Kong and Macao without case-by-case approval. The pilot covers nine cities including Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Zhuhai. Companies must obtain data protection certification and commit to complying with Hong Kong and Macao laws. While the policy reduces compliance costs, firms should still address regulatory differences and maintain internal data classification and transfer records.
policy.source_en: Source: Information Office of Guangdong Provincial People's Government · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期结束，出海企业需提前布局碳合规
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进口商须购买CBAM证书。中国钢铁、铝、水泥等行业出口企业将面临直接成本上升。建议企业立即开展产品碳足迹核算，完善供应链碳排放数据收集，并考虑在合同中加入碳成本转嫁条款；同时关注欧盟认可的中国碳价抵扣机制，必要时调整市场布局。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: EU CBAM Transition Ends Soon — Chinese Exporters Must Act on Carbon Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends in late 2026, and from 2027 importers must purchase CBAM certificates. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminum, and cement will face direct cost increases. Companies should immediately conduct product carbon footprint accounting, improve supply chain emissions data collection, and consider adding carbon cost pass-through clauses in contracts. They should also monitor EU recognition of Chinese carbon pricing offsets and adjust market strategies as needed.
